ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory identification and verification of all beneficial owners, managers, and authorized agents against: (i) the French asset-freeze (GEL/DHT) lists published by the Direction générale du Trésor (DGT); (ii) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list; (iii) the UN Security Council consolidated list; (iv) the OFAC SDN list; and (v) national and international Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) databases, applying enhanced due diligence under Articles L561-4-1, L561-5 and R561-18 CMF whenever a PEP, close associate, or family member is identified. All screening results must be documented in the KYC file and retained for five years pursuant to Article L561-42 CMF; any suspicious transaction or unresolved adverse finding must be reported to TRACFIN.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet Unique Électronique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and the Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RNCS) electronic database (data.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The dénomination sociale must be written in Latin alphabetic characters; any non-Latin script name or term must be transliterated into standard French romanization before filing. The articles of association (statuts) must be drafted in French for registration purposes, and the corporate name must not mislead as to the legal form (SARL), the activity actually exercised, or the regulatory status of the goods (in particular, no deceptive reference to a CE mark before conformity assessment and ANSM notification).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque; Banquier; Crédit; Finance; Épargne (reserved under Article L511-1 CMF; prior ACPR authorization mandatory)
Assurance; Mutuelle; Courtage d'assurance (prior ACPR authorization mandatory)
France; National; République; Département; Commune; Hôpital; Université (state emblems and regulated institutional titles requiring prior administrative consent)
SA; SAS; EURL; SNC; SCI (legal-form denominations inconsistent with a SARL and misleading to third parties)
Stérile; Dispositif médical; CE 0xxx; Médical (deceptive use concerning ANSM notification or MDR conformity of the nitrile gloves before certification is completed)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not operate a statutory pre-reservation of corporate names in the RCS; the dénomination sociale is examined by the Greffier du Tribunal de Commerce at the moment of filing through the guichet unique. Within 15 days of notification of a refusal or a formal request for regularization (injonction de régulariser), the incorporator may (i) rectify and resubmit the filing electronically, or (ii) lodge an appeal (recours) with the President of the Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office's judicial district, who supervises the registry, presenting the name-compatibility evidence. Concurrently, the applicant may file a preliminary trademark application with INPI or obtain the prior consent of the conflicting title holder to enable registration. No statutory extension of the 30-day operational validity window is available, except where a preliminary INPI trademark application protects the contested denomination.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is permitted in France only through an authorized domiciliation company (agréée by the Préfecture under Article L123-11-2 of the Code de commerce) or at the manager's personal residence with formal shareholder approval and filing of a déclaration de domiciliation. For the target activity (medical PPE manufacturing/import), the authorized domiciliation route is accepted for administrative registration, but the company must maintain a physical operational address accessible to ANSM, customs, and tax authorities for in-depth inspections; reliance solely on a virtual office without a functional storage or distribution address is not advisable and may be treated as absence of commercial substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: estimated 70% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by ANSM (medical-device conformity) and/or DGFiP (tax verification) within the first 24 months of operation for a class I/IIa sterile glove importer/manufacturer profile; probability rises to 85% if the company files VAT credit claims or qualifies for R&D tax credit, and the likelihood of a customs (DGDDI) physical inspection of goods is 40% per import declaration batch.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (Livre II, Titre II, Chapitre II : Sociétés à responsabilité limitée), articles L. 223-1 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed and paid-up capital of 1 Euro; no escrow account required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At the inaugural meeting of the sole shareholder and Board of Directors of the Company, held on the date of incorporation, the following resolutions were unanimously adopted: (1) Incorporation of the Company as a French Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SARL) with a share capital of one (1) Euro; (2) Subscription by the sole shareholder of the entire initial share capital of one (1) Euro; (3) Adoption of the registered office at [full address]; (4) Appointment of [full name of appointed Gérant] as legal representative (Gérant) with full powers of management and representation; (5) Approval of the Articles of Association as drafted; and (6) Authorization for the Gérant to execute all necessary documents for statutory formation and initial operations. This resolution establishes the foundational corporate governance structure and confirms compliance with French corporate law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and signing of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare detailed Articles of Association including corporate object, capital structure, manager appointment, registered office, and other provisions. The sole shareholder signs the Acte constitutif. Submit the original signed document to the registry along with supporting documents.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for incompleteness, provide additional documentation within the prescribed period to cure the defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for formal defects, resubmit rectified documents within the cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE and Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce

step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Appeal or correction if publication or extract issues arise.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first shareholders' meeting to ratify board resolutions, appoint officers, and adopt internal regulations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify minutes if necessary to ensure compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident or foreign entities register via Guichet Unique des Entreprises (GUE) or appoint fiscal representative; obtain SIREN/SIRET and French VAT identification number (FR + SIREN) under Code Général des Impôts
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections available; taxation follows default entity-level rules

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturation Électronique de Titre (FET) for B2B transactions; real-time digital stamping and API reporting required for clearance

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for goods physically exported outside the EU or to free zones, subject to proof of export and non-reimbursement within the EU
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims result in penalties up to 80% of evaded tax plus interest; retrospective clawback and potential criminal prosecution

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (French central bank), acting with the French Ministry of Economy and Finance; the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) supervises banking licensing, payment institutions and anti-money-laundering compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a fully convertible jurisdiction within the EU single market: current-account payments and capital-account operations benefit from free movement of capital under Article 63 TFEU. No exchange-control permit is required to inject equity, pay trade invoices, or repatriate profits. Practical hurdles are limited to documentary KYC/AML review and, for profits distributed from a French SARL, French withholding tax at the applicable rate or tax treaty rate. Neither current-account nor capital-account convertibility is restricted by foreign exchange laws; non-resident shareholders may freely receive distributable dividends after corporate formalities and tax declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Mandatory surrender ratio: 0% (none). France does not impose a statutory timeline for repatriation or conversion of export proceeds; exporters may keep foreign-currency receipts in French or EU bank accounts. The only compliance duties are (i) preserving underlying export invoices, transport documents and customs declarations for at least ten years for French corporate records, and (ii) supporting the Banque de France balance-of-payments declaration (REX) filed automatically by the bank for cross-border payment flows above the statutory threshold. No prior authorisation is needed for retention or conversion of export earnings.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium (constrained). A regulated EEA/EMI passported to France may be used only as a supplementary collection/disbursement rail after a domestic French bank relationship is established. Such an EMI cannot validly hold the SARL statutory capital escrow, cannot issue the deposit certificate (certificat de dépôt des fonds) required for incorporation, and cannot replace the Banque de France reporting obligation. Offshore EMIs established outside the EEA are treated as non-resident financial institutions; French tier-1 banks generally refuse to treat them as forming a compliant KYC chain and will require source-of-funds documentation through a regulated correspondent bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for the SARL gérant or any authorised signatory opening a corporate account with a French tier-1 bank. Remote onboarding is not a standard practice for newly formed or non-French-managed SARLs. The director must appear in person with original passport and proof of address; non-resident directors may be required to attend at a French branch or to deliver a notarised power of attorney with apostille and certified French translation. A physical or supervised video KYC interview is generally required before bank signature cards are signed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: New SARL with no established French commercial footprint and no verifiable local buyers in the medical PPE sector.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the completed SIRENE/INSEE registration, VAT number, EORI number, signed purchase orders or distribution agreements with French hospitals or medical wholesalers, ISO 13485 certificate or CE technical documentation for sterile examination gloves, customs clearance evidence, registered office lease, and the SARL business plan demonstrating real economic activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owners reside outside France and the corporate chain includes opaque or shell-like holding structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a certified group organisational chart, register of beneficial owners (RCS/UBO extract), apostilled constitutional documents of each intermediate holding company, audited financial statements, tax residence certificates, source-of-wealth reports, sanction/PEP screening documents for every shareholder above 25%, and a clear funding path from the ultimate shareholder to the French bank account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial paid-up capital is to be injected by a non-resident shareholder via a third-country bank with no pre-existing banking relationship in France.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the bank reference and compliance score of the sending institution, six months of corroborating bank statements, the signed shareholder resolution approving the capital contribution, proof that the funds arise from lawful business profits, the underlying commercial contracts, and a sworn statement of source of funds acceptable to the French bank's AML officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The non-resident shareholder must remit the SARL capital contribution by SWIFT MT103 in EUR or USD to a French bank or to the blocked capital account (compte bloqué) opened by the manager before incorporation. The bank issues a certificat de dépôt des fonds as required for the notary and the RCS registration. The payment narrative must state 'Apport en capital social – FR_SARL – [shareholder name]' and the French bank reports the flow to the Banque de France under REX where the statutory threshold is exceeded. After incorporation, the blocked account is released to the operational account upon presentation of the RCS registration certificate. No FX licence is required; the receiving bank will verify the amount against the SARL articles of association and the capital certificate.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for routine commercial supplier payments, with full beneficiary IBAN/BIC, invoice number, Incoterms and customs export reference in the payment narrative. For high-value or strategic imports of raw materials and sterilisation equipment, use an irrevocable documentary letter of credit (Commercial L/C) issued by the French bank under UCP600 through a confirmed advising bank. No foreign exchange authorisation is needed, but the bank requires underlying contracts, pro-forma invoices, transport documents and customs declarations to comply with REX statistical reporting and international trade sanctions screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX outright forwards (deliverable) against EUR/USD and other convertible currencies, with tenor matching the trade exposure
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted or thinly convertible non-EU currencies where only offshore settlement is available
FX swaps and currency swaps covering short-term rollover and cross-currency liquidity mismatches
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for medium-term hedging of USD-denominated trade finance facilities, subject to EMIR margining rules and ACPR counterparty eligibility

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements and management report deposit (Dépot des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS registry) via Infogreffe
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of fiscal year-end, and deposit with the registry no later than 1 month after shareholder approval; for a 31 December year-end, filing due no later than 30 September
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts administrative fines up to EUR 2,000 per account item; repeated default triggers merger of the SARL from the business register (radiation) and loss of liability shield in claim disputes

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Déclaration de résultats and annexes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFIP - Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 31 December fiscal year-end, filing by the second working day after 1 May; for any other year-end, within 4 months of the closing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of assessed tax, plus monthly interest of 0.20%; intentional late filing increases penalty to 40%; failure to file corporate tax returns can trigger a EUR 1,500 fixed fine

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership declaration update (Déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs - DBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Infogreffe, RCS ancillary register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No fixed annual date; must be filed within 15 days after any change in beneficial ownership; accuracy must be confirmed through the annual registry update accompanying the annual accounts deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or knowingly inaccurate declaration subjects the SARL to a fine up to EUR 37,500 and a fine up to EUR 7,500 for the manager; additionally, the company may be prohibited from invoking dummy-cause exemptions against third parties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Territorial Economic Contribution annual declaration and CET/CFE settlement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFIP - local tax office (Service des Impôts des Entreprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual declaration of cotisation foncière des entreprises (CFE) submitted by 30 April for the prior calendar year, with the tax payable by 15 December; cotisation sur la valeur ajoutée des entreprises (CVAE) declaration due by 3 May
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers a 5% surcharge plus monthly interest; omissions or deficiencies in the Declaration of tax amounts may attract a 10% penalty applied to the undeclared base

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit (Commissaire aux Comptes) required for a SARL exceeding at least two of the following thresholds: total balance sheet EUR 4 million, net turnover EUR 8 million, or 50 employees; audit also triggered by legal form, holding-company status, or shareholder request
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général - PCG) conforming to the 2013/34/EU Directive; adoption of IFRS optional for consolidated annual statements but not for standalone SARL reports

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL must perform an annual internal review of its register of beneficial owners in conjunction with the ordinary shareholders' approval of the annual accounts; any share transfer changing the identity or percentage of a beneficial owner mandates an updated DBE filed with the Greffe within 15 days. Annual confirmation is performed by declaring the continued accuracy of all recorded beneficial ownership details in the registry reconciliation at the time of account deposit.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Movable Asset Leases and Pledge Agreements

stage_6.royalty_statutory_rate_fr: 33.33% (CGI art. 1678 bis) on patent royalties paid to non-residents; treaty-reduced rates commonly 0%–10%
stage_6.interest_statutory_rate_fr: 0% on arm's-length interest paid by a French corporate debtor to unrelated non-resident lenders; anti-avoidance 15%/30% exposure for payments to non-cooperative jurisdictions or hybrid mismatch arrangements
stage_6.eu_directive_relief: 0% under EU Interest-Royalties Directive for qualifying associated EU companies (≥25% direct holding for continuous period of 2 years, plus effective substance requirement)
